data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding, net of reinsurance recoveries is a favourable development of GBP 17.8m (2015: favourable development of GBP 16.6m); this comprises releases of GBP 17.4m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business, releases of GBP 0.2m in respect of direct Aviation and Transport business and GBP 0.2m in respect of total Reinsurance business.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1218 recorded net favourable prior year reserve development in 2016. The managing agent reports net releases (favourable development) mainly in Casualty (Third Party Liability) with smaller releases in Aviation and Reinsurance. On a gross basis the claims development triangle indicates a net release of approximately GBP 8.94m across the older underwriting years (2011-2014). The disclosed net movement (after reinsurance) was a GBP 17.8m favourable development, driven primarily by releases in direct Third Party Liability.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable development of GBP 17.8m (2015: favourable development of GBP 16.6m); this comprises releases of GBP 17.4m in respect of direct Third Party Liability business, releases of GBP 0.2m in respect of direct Aviation and Transport business and GBP 0.2m in respect of total Reinsurance business.
prior year releases across a number of Casualty classes.
data.data_quality_notes: The managing agent explicitly discloses the prior year movement only on a net (after reinsurance) basis (GBP 17.8m favourable). The gross prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development table (triangle) excluding the aggregated '2010 & prior' column which cannot be diagonal-compared; therefore the gross PYD (-GBP 8.941m) may not include changes within the aggregated older years and is a conservative triangle-derived figure. Net and gross figures differ materially; use caution interpreting gross vs net.
